animals and birds.text: Animals sense things first, and horror trusts them: a barking dog or a bolting horse is often the earliest sign that something is wrong, and the image turns up in more than half the films of every era. At the Perron farmhouse [the dog will not go inside|2013-the-conjuring], and on the Haywood ranch [the horses panic before animals vanish into a cloud|2022-nope]. Sometimes the animal itself turns, as when [a rescued sled dog transforms in its kennel|1982-the-thing], or when the twins swear [their billy goat Black Phillip talks to them|2015-the-witch].

babies, birth and pregnancy.text: A baby is the most hopeful thing a story can hold, which is why horror keeps putting it in danger, from the cradle and the nursery to the pregnant belly and the child that never lives. The image barely exists before 1960 and gathers in films made after 2000. In Tumbbad [a starving god lives inside the womb of the goddess of prosperity|2018-tumbbad], and in Border, Tina [helps police hunt the people trafficking abused infants|2018-border] while wondering about the baby. The same image runs through Rosemary's Baby, The Brood, Inside and Huesera.

blood.text: Blood is the body's secret made visible, and once it is spilled there is no hiding what has happened. It is rare in films before 1960 and common ever since, and it can mean many things. In a poet's country house [blood will not stop dripping into the floor|2017-mother], while in Santa Carla [Michael drinks from a bottle of it|1987-the-lost-boys] and soon shuns the light. For Zaffan in Tiger Stripes [a first period|2023-tiger-stripes] is the start of a frightening change, as her skin breaks out and her nails fall away.

books, letters and writing.text: Writing outlasts the hand that made it, so a diary or a book in a horror film is a voice from the past that will not stay quiet, and the image grows steadily more common from the 1980s on. Father Malone [finds the founders' secret in his grandfather's hidden diary|1980-the-fog], and words scrawled on a wall [call Eleanor home to Hill House|1963-the-haunting]. Amelia tears up a pop-up book called Mister Babadook, only to find [it back on her doorstep with new pages|2014-the-babadook]. In Chanderi, the townsfolk [paint words on their walls to keep a spirit moving on|2018-stree].

buildings and public places.text: Public buildings are made for crowds, and horror finds them at their emptiest: the closed school, the deserted ward, the palace no one lives in. Jim [wakes from a coma in a deserted London hospital|2002-28-days-later], Hari Shankar [moves into an abandoned palace in Allahabad|1949-mahal], and Laura [returns to the closed orphanage where she grew up|2007-the-orphanage]. In Dakar [a gleaming tower nears its opening|2019-atlantics] while the men who built it go unpaid, and after they are lost at sea they return at night inside the bodies of the living.

clothes, jewellery and keepsakes.text: Clothes keep the shape of the person who wore them, so a coat or a ring can stand in for someone lost, or mark someone for death. In Venice John Baxter [keeps glimpsing a small figure in a red coat|1973-don-t-look-now] like the one his drowned daughter wore. In Chanderi [a spirit takes the men and leaves only their clothes|2018-stree], and in Gokseong, Jong-goo finds [his daughter's shoe in a stranger's shrine of the dead|2016-the-wailing]. The image is commonest of all in films made since 2015.

corpses and body parts.text: The dead body is the one thing every living person will become, and horror cannot stop looking at it, whole, hanged, hidden or in pieces. In a rural town two brothers [find a disembowelled corpse in the woods|2023-when-evil-lurks], and in Adelaide a party game turns on [an embalmed severed hand|2022-talk-to-me]. A travelling doctor's blood [falls onto the witch's corpse in her crypt|1960-black-sunday] and wakes her, while in Saw two men [wake chained in a derelict bathroom with a corpse between them|2004-saw].

dolls, masks and likenesses.text: A mask or a doll keeps a human face while emptying it of a human mind, and this fear lives in the gap between the two. The ventriloquist's dummy Hugo [talks of leaving him for a rival|1945-dead-of-night], and Michael Myers comes home [in a white mask stolen from a hardware store|1978-halloween]. Annie Graham [builds miniature rooms in her Utah home|2018-hereditary] as grief settles over her family, and in The Orphanage, Simón [draws his new friend as a boy in a sack mask|2007-the-orphanage].

fire, smoke and burning.text: Fire cleanses and destroys at once, and in horror it is often how a community tries to bury its sins, only for them to come back. Fred Krueger [was burned alive by the parents of Elm Street|1984-a-nightmare-on-elm-street] and now hunts their children through their dreams, while Nancy burns herself to wake up. In the house at 112 Ocean Avenue George Lutz [grows obsessed with keeping the fire fed|1979-the-amityville-horror]. The image peaks in films of the 1980s and 1990s, falls away after 2000 and returns after 2015.

food, drink and drugs.text: Eating is an act of trust, and horror poisons it, so that a meal, a cup of tea or a glass of milk can carry something in. The nightmare at the lakeside house starts when a polite young man [asks to borrow eggs|1997-funny-games], and in apartment 13B [the milk curdles every day|2009-13b]. Rose's mother [stirs a spoon in a teacup|2017-get-out] and Chris drops into the sunken place. At veterinary school Justine, a lifelong vegetarian, [is made to swallow a raw rabbit kidney|2016-raw], and a hunger she is ashamed of follows.

gatherings, games and closeness.text: Parties, weddings and games bring people close, and horror uses that closeness against them, turning a celebration into a trap with everyone already inside. On her wedding night Grace [draws Hide-and-Seek from a puzzle box|2019-ready-or-not] and her new in-laws each take up a weapon. Two polite young men [play sadistic games with a family through one long night|1997-funny-games], betting none of them will live until morning, and in Haddonfield the holiday dark [lets Michael move from house to house along Laurie's street|1978-halloween].

ghosts and strange figures.text: A figure shaped like a person, standing where no person should be, is the oldest picture of a ghost and still the most reliable. Miss Giddens [sees a man and a woman in the grounds that only she seems to notice|1961-the-innocents], and Cole Sear [confides that he sees dead people|1999-the-sixth-sense]. Pale faces [surface in Tun's photographs|2004-shutter] after the girl left on the road, and in Derry the figure is a clown in a storm drain, [waiting for a small boy chasing a paper sailboat|2017-it].

graves, coffins and funerals.text: The rites of burial are meant to close a story, and horror keeps opening them again. The image is strongest in the oldest films and fades after 2000. Orlok [sails for Wisborg among coffins full of rats|1922-nosferatu], Barbra and Johnny are attacked [while visiting their father's grave|1968-night-of-the-living-dead], and a hearse driver in Dead of Night returns as a bus conductor with just room for one inside. In Hereditary [Ellen's grave is vandalised|2018-hereditary] soon after her funeral.

holy and occult objects.text: Charms and crosses promise protection, and horror tests every one of them, often finding the object stronger than the faith behind it. Regan [finds a spirit board and talks with Captain Howdy|1973-the-exorcist], and a travelling doctor [breaks the cross over the witch's tomb|1960-black-sunday]. Joy [hangs a found bagua mirror at her door for luck|2004-feng-shui], and it takes a soul for every stroke of good fortune. In Ugetsu only a priest who paints sacred symbols on his body can loosen Lady Wakasa's hold on the potter.

household objects and machines.text: The ordinary things of a home are meant to sit unnoticed, and horror makes them watchful, so that a clock, a box or an appliance becomes a place where something waits. In the Perron farmhouse [every clock stops at 3:07 in the morning|2013-the-conjuring]. Shuichi's father, obsessed with anything that curls, [crawls into a washing machine to die|2000-uzumaki]. Asami sits motionless by her phone for days, and in her bare apartment [a large sack moves|1999-audition].

mirrors and glass.text: A mirror should give back exactly what stands before it, so the slightest error in a reflection unsettles the whole world. In Dead of Night [a mirror shows a husband another man's room|1945-dead-of-night], and in Santa Carla [Michael's reflection begins to fade|1987-the-lost-boys] as he craves blood. Kaylie [surrounds the antique mirror she blames with cameras|2013-oculus] and an anchor rigged to smash it. The image turns up about twice as often in British and Irish films as in North American ones.

monsters and hybrid creatures.text: A monster is a body that belongs to no known kind, and the closer it comes to the human, the worse it feels. Dr. Moreau [shapes animals into people|1932-island-of-lost-souls], and the gentle Lota's fingernails turn back into claws. The Pale Man [eats children in his lair|2006-pan-s-labyrinth], and a creature [born of the poisoned Han River|2006-the-host] carries Hyun-seo down into the water. The image is entirely absent from the South and Southeast Asian films in the record.

pictures, screens and recordings.text: Cameras were meant to fix the world in place, and horror finds that a recording can carry the dead along with the living. Reiko [watches a cursed videotape and her seven days begin|1998-ringu]. In his attic Ellison Oswalt [finds Super 8 reels that each film a family's murder|2012-sinister], and on channel 13 a serial [shows a family just like Manohar's|2009-13b] and what happens on screen soon happens to them. On their ranch OJ and Em [set out to catch the thing in the cloud on camera|2022-nope] and sell the shot.

plants, trees and fungus.text: Plants grow without asking, and horror imagines that slow, patient life turning toward us, an image most common in films made since 2015. In the Tsitsikamma forest [mushrooms sprout from living flesh|2021-gaia], and inside the Shimmer [plants grow into human shapes|2018-annihilation]. On a remote Welsh island [the goddess lies bound in tree roots|2018-apostle] and fed on blood. In Bees Saal Baad the dread gathers at a single tree, where Kumar's father and grandfather were killed.

ropes, cages and executions.text: Chains, nooses and cages are made by people for holding and killing people, and their cold design is part of the fear. Adam and Lawrence [wake chained by the ankle in a derelict bathroom|2004-saw], and an actress is made to [reshoot a hanging until her safety sling snaps|2008-coming-soon]. In a cave, priests [offer a caged boy to the witch Nakita|1988-veerana]. The image peaks in films made between 2000 and 2014, though it reaches back to Kong, [brought to a Broadway stage in chains|1933-king-kong].

sounds, smells and silence.text: Sound reaches us before sight does, and horror uses it to make the unseen present: a song in an empty room, a knock in the night, a voice heard by one person alone. It is commonest of all in the oldest films. A woman's singing [draws Hari Shankar through the empty rooms|1949-mahal], and Kumar [hears a woman singing from the swamp at night|1962-bees-saal-baad]. At Hill House [something pounds at the bedroom door|1963-the-haunting], and a former dictator [hears a woman weeping in the dark|2019-la-llorona].

the house and its rooms.text: The house is where we are supposed to be safe, and this fear lives in its parts, the cellar, the attic, the locked room and the wall that should be solid. In Black Christmas [the calls are coming from inside the house|1974-black-christmas], and the Perrons [uncover a boarded-up cellar|2013-the-conjuring]. Behind a basement wall the Lutz family find [a small red room|1979-the-amityville-horror], and in a poet's country house his young wife glimpses [a heart beating inside the walls|2017-mother].

vehicles and roads.text: Vehicles promise escape and shut us in, and horror loves a moving room with no way out. On the express to Busan [the dead surge through the carriages|2016-train-to-busan], and in a new tower block [the lift works for everyone but Manohar|2009-13b]. A sick driver [plunges the police van into a lake|2015-baskin] and leaves his officers on foot. Grief itself often starts on the road, as with [the car crash that kills Sarah's husband and daughter|2005-the-descent] a year before she goes underground.

vermin and creeping things.text: Creatures that swarm, crawl and multiply carry the old dread of rot and plague, and of a world that would carry on happily without us. Orlok's ship brings [coffins full of rats|1922-nosferatu] to Wisborg, the priest who blesses the Lutz house [is swarmed by flies|1979-the-amityville-horror], and at the Freiburg academy [maggots rain from the ceiling|1977-suspiria]. In Phenomena the insects are drawn to Jennifer, and when classmates taunt her [she summons a swarm of flies over the whole school|1985-phenomena].

water and drowning.text: Water is where a body can vanish without trace, and horror keeps returning to it as a place the dead come back from. Sadako [was sealed inside a well|1998-ringu], and her rage was recorded onto tape. Little Christine [drowns at home|1973-don-t-look-now], and in Venice her father keeps glimpsing a red coat like hers. The new maid Alma, once seen wading through the pool into the house, [teaches the granddaughter to hold her breath under water|2019-la-llorona].

weapons and tools.text: A blade brings death within reach of a hand, and horror has kept a knife close since its earliest days. A shadowy figure [finds Marion in the shower with a kitchen knife|1960-psycho], and a disfigured man [stalks Tina and Nancy through their dreams with a bladed glove|1984-a-nightmare-on-elm-street]. Brent wakes bound to a chair [between the tiara and the drill|2009-the-loved-ones], and in films from Australia and New Zealand the image appears almost every time.

weather, sky and darkness.text: Weather is the world's mood made visible, and horror lets fog, rain and darkness carry what the characters cannot yet see. [A glowing fog rolls in from the sea|1980-the-fog] carrying the drowned crew of the Elizabeth Dane, and Grace [keeps her house in darkness|2001-the-others] because her children cannot bear the light. Over the Haywood ranch [a cloud in the valley never moves|2022-nope]. In [the rain-cursed village of Tumbbad|2018-tumbbad] a forgotten god starves for the grain he was denied.

wild and lonely places.text: Away from roads and houses the land itself becomes the threat, too old and too large to care who enters it, and the image grows far more common after 2000. Miranda, Marion and Irma [walk in a trance into a crevice in Hanging Rock|1975-picnic-at-hanging-rock], and only Irma is found. Sarah and her friends [are trapped in an unmapped cave system|2005-the-descent] with pale creatures that hunt by sound. William's family [build a farm at the edge of a vast forest|2015-the-witch] where baby Samuel vanishes.

wounded and changing bodies.text: The fear of a body going wrong is the most intimate of all, because there is no leaving it. The words 'help me' [rise on Regan's stomach from within|1973-the-exorcist], and Steven's children [lose the use of their legs|2017-the-killing-of-a-sacred-deer] and will bleed from the eyes. In Kurouzu-cho classmates [sprout shells as their bodies twist out of shape|2000-uzumaki]. The image has grown since the 1970s and is now found in nearly half the films made since 2015.
